daily.career: Your ideas hit different today. That project you've been sitting on? Now's the time to pitch it or take action. Your collaborative energy is strong—don't be shy about reaching out to allies.
daily.health: Your body's asking for balance, not intensity. A slow walk, some stretching, or even just sitting with your thoughts will do wonders. Listen to what feels nourishing rather than what feels productive.
